import {Link, Post} from "./Post"; import welcome from "./assets/welcome.png"; export const WelcomePost = (

Hey there! I'm Michael Liu. Below is a catalog of all the projects I've worked on!


I'll try to post here regularly. If I make a blog post a month, I'll have achieved my goal. If I make a blog post a week, then I'll probably get hired somewhere.


The goal of this blog isn't to get hired, though! I just want to be able to look back on these projects and see the trajectory of my growth over these years, as it's something I've regretted not doing.


Well, what are you waiting for? Take a look at my cool stuff!


  • hi
)
